notes.title: v1.2.0 Nightmare Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iwu6F64.png[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]

[h3]Added a new Nightmare difficulty level[/h3]
[list]
[*]Nightmare difficulty now replaces Hardcore difficulty.
[*]Nightmare is substantially harder, and is meant for players who found Hard too easy.
[*]Existing save files can switch to Nightmare difficulty in the Options menu.
[/list]
[h3]Added a Standard or Hardcore game mode selection[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Standard[/b]: Units will respawn after being defeated in combat.
[*][b]Hardcore[/b]: Units cannot be used again after being defeated in combat (aka. perma-death).
[*]Previous saves made on the old Hardcore difficulty will now use the new Hardcore game mode. 
[*]Saves made on the new Hardcore mode will have a purple heart on their save file.
[*]Standard or Hardcore modes can only be selected when making a New Game, and cannot be changed later.
[/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced enemy difficulty in the third fight of the Dew Meadows.
[*]Increased the chest time in the fight to the right of the town in the Dew Meadows.
[*]Increased the chest time in the secret fight in the Coral Oasis.
[*]Increased the chest time in the fight above the maze in the Kingdom of Grandia.
[*]Moved a Bomb Pillow in the first Colosseum fight.
[/list]
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Detonate Pillow[/b][list]
[*]No longer increases in damage per debuff type on the Pillow by default.
[*]This effect has been moved to [b]Miniature Coffin[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Cascading Frost[/b][list]
[*]Increased INT scaling from 120 to 140.
[*]Reduced Area of Effect from 3 to 2 tiles.
[/list]
[*][b]Fire Trap[/b][list]
[*]Increased duration from 3 to 5 turns.
[/list]
[*][b]Ice Trap[/b][list]
[*]Increased duration from 3 to 5 turns.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Equipment[/h2]

Added three new items to the Tier 5 shop:
[list]
[*][b]Bottled Fairy[/b]
[*][b]Spiked Sallet[/b]
[*][b]Mirror Shield[/b]
[/list]Check them out in-game to see what they do!

[list]
[*][b]Heart Bracelet[/b][list]
[*]Now applies [b]Stim[/b] to enemies that already have [b]Charm[/b].
[*]Reduced MP gained from 2 to 1.
[/list]
[*][b]Spotter's Scope[/b][list]
[*]Increased INT and DEX scaling to 100.
[*]Now sets [b]Snipe[/b] to always have 5 range.
[/list]
[*][b]Retaliator[/b][list]
[*]Now always activates when dodging an attack.
[*]Reduced DEX scaling from 150 to 140.
[/list]
[*][b]Glass Platemail[/b][list]
[*]Reduced HP gained from 50% to 40%.
[/list]
[*][b]Miniature Coffin[/b][list]
[*]No longer inflicts all debuffs to adjacent enemies when detonating a Pillow.
[*]Instead, it now provides 40% more damage per debuff type on the Pillow.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Steam Achievements were not being awarded when launching the game without an internet connection.
[*]Fixed a bug where enemy damage forecasting was incorrect on Easy and Medium difficulties.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Retaliator[/b] did not attack friendly units when used with [b]Friendly Fire[/b].
[*]Fixed a translation error with [b]Shadow's Blindfold[/b] in Simplified Chinese (thanks vtxtune!)
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0 Epilogue Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xfDpO5x.png[/img]

Since the launch of Dream Tactics, we've received a lot of positive and passionate feedback from our players. We set out to create the best strategy RPG we could, and we cannot express how happy it makes us to see everyone enjoying it.

That being said, we realized that one aspect of the game—the ending—did not meet the expectations of many of our players, and we wanted to address that.

In this update, we're proud to announce that we've written a new epilogue for the game, which will play after the credits roll.

Additionally, to celebrate, [b]Dream Tactics will be on sale for 20% off from May 27th 10:00AM PDT until June 3rd 10:00AM PDT[/b]! Thank you all for your support, and we hope to continue making Dream Tactics the best it can be.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897650/Dream_Tactics/

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new epilogue cutscene after defeating Dream Eater.
[*]Lowered the damage of the Dark Flame traps in Ashguard by 33%.
[*]Chest completion for the Empire of Ashguard will now exclude chests that are not yet obtainable.
[*]Barricades in the Empire of Ashguard will now be automatically removed when finishing a fight.
[*]Minor adjustments to the wording around stat scaling.
[*]Polished Japanese localization.
[/list]
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Dagger Throw[/b][list][*]Now scales with 60 STR and DEX.[/list][*][b]Shuriken[/b][list][*]Now scales with 50 DEX and AGI.[/list][*][b]Head Shot[/b][list][*]Now gives +3% CRIT per [b]Rose[/b] stack, instead of modifying the card's base critical hit chance.[/list][*][b]Melee (Summon Nightmare)[/b][list][*]Increased STR scaling from 80 to 100.[/list][*][b]Assassinate[/b][list][*]Decreased LUK scaling from 100 to 80.[/list][*][b]Clone[/b][list][*][b]Decoy[/b] now increases damage taken by 100% (from 50%).[/list]
[/list][h2]Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Lucky Star[/b][list]
[*]Reduced the LUK scaling of Star Slam from 100% to 80%.
[/list]
[/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Thermometer[/b] and [b]Friendly Fire[/b] did not affect the damage of [b]Reignite[/b] or [b]Wild Fire[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where teleporting the party in combat could overwrite units that were there previously.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Temporal Bracers[/b] did not apply when refreshing status effects with a 1 turn duration.
[*]Fixed a bug where duplicate controls were present when inspecting cards while fielding units.
[*]Fixed rounding errors in stat scaling when using [b]Heartwood Bow[/b].
[*]Fixed a potential crash when using [b]Cold Snap[/b].
[*]Fixed a potential crash when failing a fight.
[/list]
You can join us over on [url=https://discord.gg/GkZNhS36mT#]Discord[/url]; we would love to hear your thoughts on our epilogue!

And if you haven’t yet, we’d greatly appreciate it if you left us an honest review on Steam. Steam reviews are incredibly important for indie games as it allows more players like yourselves to discover Dream Tactics.

notes.title: Dreamweaver's Journal: September 2023
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

Welcome back to the Dreamweaver's Journal! We hope you are all well as we ease into fall (at least here in the northern hemisphere). As usual, we have been hard at work developing Dream Tactics, and we are happy to report that we have been making great progress. Speaking of which, here are some of the features that we have been working on and are most excited about!

[b][h3]The World Map[/h3][/b]

We started the month by creating an area map! This feature makes it much easier to understand where you have been and where you have yet to explore. Let’s take a closer look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/b440864b3c350af8b1538317d8e6829f1c5ff65d.png[/img]

The map grows with every step you take, marking along the way the areas you have visited. Of course, front and centre, your party leader icon marks where you are in relation to the level. In addition, the map is colour-coded to help describe more about what you have to explore:
[list]
[*] Red sections mark that there is more to explore in that direction.
[*] Green sections mark where the entrances and exits to the level are.
[/list]
[h3][b]Willow[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/6ee9958413fca7342ea345db6c145701e6e7f5b9.png[/img]

The Dream World’s resident mad scientist, Willow, has created a top-secret research facility deep within the nightmare region of the Dream World. Within the labyrinth of labs and testing facilities, you can find Willow pursuing her passion of studying humans and their unparalleled power within the Dream World.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/8d2bc7447147d9de28687485f1bd85233232ec7b.png[/img]

Willow's specialty is minion mastery. She possesses the ability to summon enemy pillows into battle that she can manipulate as she pleases. While normally summoning enemies is a disadvantage for the player, Willow’s cards synergize with these summoned pillows by means of their Minion status effect.

[b]Charm[/b] is one of Willow's most powerful cards. It lets her brainwash a pillow into doing her bidding, which means it will pursue and attack other pillows, offering valuable assistance to you and your team. Normally this card has a very low hit rate, but when played on pillows that were summoned by Willow, this card has a 100% chance to it.

If brainwashing pillows are too subtle for your tastes, you can always use [b]Detonate Pillow[/b]. This card allows Willow to turn any regular pillow into a powerful bomb that can wreak havoc on the enemy forces. Simply summon a pillow somewhere behind enemy lines and then follow up with Detonate Pillow for an easy one-two punch that can deal some serious damage to your opponents.

[h3][b]Detonate Plate[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/b0b4461908285adcad821f665bce90776092767a.gif[/img]

[b]Detonate Plate[/b] is one of the new pieces of equipment that we have implemented, and it is quickly becoming one of our favourites! [b]Detonate Plate[/b] is an item meant to be equipped on your tankiest and most defensive units.

Specifically, when a unit wearing [b]Detonate Plate[/b] is attacked by physical damage, they cause an explosion that damages all nearby enemies. The damage produced is proportional to the amount of damage the unit's defense stat has mitigated. In other words, the more defense the wearer has, the more damage they will deal with [b]Detonate Plate[/b].

That's it for now. Stay tuned for future editions of the Journal, where we will keep you apprised of our latest developments. If you would like to try Dream Tactics, we encourage you to download the demo. Also, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GkZNhS36mT]Discord[/url] server if you have any questions for us and check us out on [url=https://twitter.com/spectra_dev]Twitter[/url]. We are always happy to answer any inquiries and respond to all feedback. Before you go, don't forget to give Dream Tactics a wishlist! Your support will really help make Dream Tactics the best it can be.

Thanks for reading,
Spectra Entertainment

Willow's specialty is minion mastery. She possesses the ability to summon enemy pillows into battle that she can manipulate as she pleases. While normally summoning enemies is a disadvantage for the player, Willow’s cards synergize with these summoned pillows by means of their Minion status effect.

notes.title: Dreamweaver’s Journal: August 2023
notes.content:
Hello everybody, welcome back to the Dreamweaver’s Journal, where we provide you with a brief update on the progress we've achieved with Dream Tactics! In this edition of the Journal, we aim to take you on a swift tour of one of the five worlds within the Dream World: the Coral Oasis.

[h2]The Coral Oasis[/h2]

Set far away in the furthest corner of Dream World lies the mysterious Coral Oasis. To the uninitiated, it seems like paradise found! With its white-sand beaches, perfect weather, and bountiful resources, who wouldn't want to live here? But this is the Dream World, and of course, there is a catch.

You see, once one sets foot into the oasis, they can never leave! Despite that, the Coral Oasis has a reputation for hiding the most prized and valuable treasure in all of the Dream World. This has inspired many treasure hunters and scholars to come and find the treasure, and perhaps learn about the mysterious civilizations that left it behind. It begs the question: is all the treasure to be found under its sandy shores worth the price of never being able to leave? I suppose that’s for each adventurer to answer for themselves. Regardless, in order to save the Dream World, you must venture deep within the Coral Oasis. With luck on your side, you may evade the fate that ensnared those who were once seduced by the oasis, finding themselves trapped in its sands for eternity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/d9b5c4163f06c9d67986e7d346d432ecb3598348.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/9261dda9d004e79ffb744c5e090284eb38a24e8e.png[/img]
[h2]Amber[/h2]

Amber ventured to the Coral Oasis, consumed by an unrelenting drive to unearth untold riches and discover the ultimate motherlode. Undaunted by the possibility of never departing from the oasis, she ascended the ranks among accomplished treasure hunters. She has gained considerable notoriety among the Oasis residents for her prowess and her remarkable ability to locate the most valuable treasures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/1add3725d7e4dcdf78f8c8e582ff1800b581855f.png[/img]
It's all about fire with Amber. Her fire-themed cards are some of the most powerful you will find. Not only is Amber a dominant damage dealer with her magical abilities, but nearly all of her cards have the additional effect of creating [b]Scorched Earth[/b] tiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/3b33bd341e1e01581e760fc84bd11c9e3b96d5c7.gif[/img]

[b]Scorched Earth[/b] applies fire to the tile underneath where a unit is standing. If a unit is standing on or walks into a Scorched Earth tile, they will receive a [b]Burn[/b] debuff. [b]Burn[/b] deals damage to the afflicted unit at the start of each turn proportional to the amount of INT that the caster of [b]Scorched Earth[/b] has. The smarter Amber gets, the more damage Burn will do!

Amber is no doubt powerful, but beware, her power can sometimes get the best of her. You see, Amber’s [b]Burn[/b] is able to damage her teammates! This catch is unique to Amber’s playstyle and those who wield her must take care not to cause too much harm to her teammates. However, Dream Tactics being a game based on builds and strategy, there may be ways to use Amber’s team damage to your advantage. But you will have to stay tuned for future editions of the Journal to learn more about that!

Each and every one of Amber's cards is powerful and will help you on your quest to save the Dream World. We wanted to take this opportunity and share with you a few of our favourites.

[h3]Fire Shot[/h3]
This card can be used to shoot a fireball far across the battlefield. If Amber is in [b]Scorched Earth[/b], this card's range doubles, allowing players to start fires in far off reaches of the battlefield

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/3fda04183a1b1774151e6185e1cd496d3eacaf76.gif[/img]

[h3]Wild Fire[/h3]
Unleashes a ferocious wave of flames that spreads [b]Scorched Earth[/b] tiles to its neighbouring areas. This card allows Amber to create a blazing inferno, and playing multiple copies of it can quickly engulf the entire battlefield in flames, catching both enemies and allies in the crossfire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/ee4e1e09a2606f4dae2de352663e30536994ce0c.gif[/img]

[h3]Kindle[/h3]
This card amplifies damage by triggering a fiery explosion on the targeted enemy each time you deal damage. The amount of inflicted damage is proportionate to the INT stat of the unit responsible for playing the [b]Kindle[/b] card. Given that [b]Kindle[/b] inflicts damage every time the target takes damage, keen players will try to pair it with other cards capable of striking multiple times, thereby optimising the potency of [b]Kindle[/b]'s effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/e84f780537a1b6681c3559f61c5acdb07d19d117.gif[/img]
There is no denying that Amber ignites the battlefield with her fiery ferocity, but she is also a valuable support unit for her team.

With cards like [b]Warmth[/b] and [b]Extinguish[/b] at her disposal, Amber can heal her teammates to keep them in the fight. Additionally, [b]Fire Swap[/b] can be used for additional movement by allowing her to swap places with an ally in [b]Scorched Earth[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/da1eba2d1657656a142b6d0c2a0f4b652473dff7.png[/img]

[h2]Treasure to be Found in The Oasis[/h2]

The Coral Oasis is known to hide the most valuable treasure in all of the Dream World, so of course you can expect to find powerful items here to help aid your quest.

[h3]Retaliator[/h3]
This item causes your unit to launch a counter-attack upon successfully evading an enemy attack. The damage inflicted during this counter-attack is directly proportional to the unit's Dexterity (DEX) attribute. By enhancing the wearer's Agility (AGI), the likelihood of evading incoming attacks is increased, thereby enhancing the overall effectiveness and dependability of the [b]Retaliator[/b].

[h3]Hiltless[/h3]
The unit equipped with this item suffers damage whenever they play a card. Initially, this might seem disadvantageous, but in Dream Tactics, numerous items exist that, when combined with [b]Hiltless[/b], can convert its drawback into your advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/ddcc7d241d196bac11e49a9c1fc840e0b2e63f25.png[/img]
Take for example [b]Star Shield[/b]. When the unit wears [b]Star Shield[/b], they acquire a [b]Tired[/b] debuff each time they take damage. This synergy can prove remarkably potent when paired with the [b]Star Hammer[/b] card. [b]Star Hammer[/b]'s damage is increased with the quantity of [b]Tired[/b] debuffs the unit possesses. Therefore, to fully exploit [b]Star Hammer[/b]'s potential, stacking as many [b]Tired[/b] debuffs as possible is essential. An effective approach to achieve this synergy is by combining [b]Hiltless[/b] with [b]Star Shield[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/b032b7f879cee4ebbeeb44a9c902c79de1adb978.png[/img]

That’s it for now. Stay tuned for future editions of the Journal where we will talk about more worlds and characters! If you would like to try Dream Tactics, we encourage you to download the demo. Also, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GkZNhS36mT]Discord[/url] server if you have any questions for us. We are always happy to answer any inquiries and respond to all feedback. Before you go, don't forget to give Dream Tactics a wishlist! Your support will really help make Dream Tactics the best it can be.

Thanks for reading,
Spectra Entertainment

notes.title: Dreamweaver’s Journal: July 2023
notes.content:
Hello everybody, welcome to Dreamweaver’s Journal, where we give you a quick update regarding all the progress we have made on Dream Tactics in the last month. The past few months have been incredibly exciting for us, especially since we have teamed up with our publishing partner, Freedom Games. We are thrilled to be working with them and are confident that this relationship will lead to great things for Dream Tactics.

With that said, here is what we have been working on!

[h3][b]1. New and Powerful Equipment:[/b][/h3]

Create unique and powerful characters with the introduction of new build-enabling equipment!

In this month’s journal, we would like to showcase some of our favourites that we’ve been working on, such as Echo Hammer:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/f3043288b0209581b9c5a3b8f740446d7bfc3392.png[/img]

Echo Hammer is a strength-scaling item that creates a powerful shockwave when your unit moves as a result of a card effect. This item synergizes perfectly with cards like Hop and Slide, which will move your unit to a new tile, triggering the item’s effect. This will allow players to build characters with high mobility without compromising on their damage! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/d4a40eb61b6ab2f16b302130dfb3d07a3761e3a1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]2. Meet the New Heroes:[/b][/h3]

The art team has been working on the character portraits and designs of two of our unlockable characters:

[list]
[*] Amber the Pyromancer: A treasure hunter focused on finding the motherlode. Amber’s playstyle is focused around setting the ground on-fire, dealing burning damage to engulfed enemies.
[*] Willow the Summoner: A master of both the dark arts and science. Willow can summon pillows to assist your party in combat, and wields powerful ice magic.
[/list]

We plan on going into more detail about these characters and their unique mechanics in future development updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/68489e78625ec2c5c8321f8c21963ed6ccf6f42b.png[/img]

[h3][b]3. Smarter Enemies:[/b][/h3]

Prepare for more challenging encounters! We've improved the enemy AI, making battles more dynamic and rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/89fd6894a47fc0f45824298083e5736bc80b4d59.gif[/img]

[h3][b]4. A Window to Progress:[/b][/h3]

We’ve added a preview to each area of the Nexus which displays your progress in collecting chests and breakables. This clear sense of achievement and completion will keep you motivated on your quest and allow you to know if you have collected everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/cf22aaecd11d106f399276ab26e488908f5731bb.png[/img]

[h3][b]5. Protecting Your Progress:[/b][/h3]

Accidental overwriting of save files can be frustrating, but fear not! We've implemented the ability to lock save files. With this feature, you can choose to lock a save file, making it impossible for you to accidentally overwrite it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42256339/c22ecd5388c3e0e2170665d16c6a95847c9e79a5.png[/img]

[h3][b]6. Saving and Loading Improvements:[/b][/h3]

We've enhanced the performance of both the saving and loading processes, ensuring that in-combat saves are now faster and more reliable than ever before.

[h3][b]7. Banishing Bugs:[/b][/h3]

Our team has been on a bug-hunting spree, and we've successfully squashed tons of these pesky critters. The game is now more polished and stable, providing a smoother gameplay experience for all players.

[h3][b]8. Presenting our Identity:[/b][/h3]

We've added a splash screen that proudly showcases our studio logo alongside the logo of our publishing partner, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/freedomgames]Freedom Games[/url].

That’s it for now. Stay tuned for future editions of the Journal! If you would like to try Dream Tactics, we encourage you to download the demo. Also, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GkZNhS36mT]Discord[/url] server if you have any questions for us. We are always happy to answer any inquiries and respond to all feedback. Before you go, don't forget to give Dream Tactics a wishlist! Your support will really help make Dream Tactics the best it can be.

Thanks for reading,
Spectra Entertainment

notes.title: Version 0.2.8 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The Merchant:[/b] This pillow will accompany Neru throughout her journey, allowing players to buy and sell items more frequently.
[*] [b]Separation of EP into Red and Blue points:[/b] Equipment will now cost either Red or Blue EP to equip, depending on whether the item is offensive or defensive.
[*] [b]New and Improved Level Up Flow:[/b] Stat increases from leveling will now be shown for each unit after combat.
[*] [b]Saving in Combat:[/b] Players can now save and exit the game in the middle of a fight, allowing them to load back in to play it later.
[*] [b]Hardcore Difficulty:[/b] Permadeath for veterans of the genre! Be wary, as once selected, this difficulty cannot be changed.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Carrot Missile:[/b] Redesigned. Now, if the unit is on top of a carrot from Harvest, this card will always deal a critical hit.
[*] [b]Star Hammer:[/b] Now scales off of both STR and INT and removes only 1 stack of Tired instead of all of them.
[*] [b]Wake:[/b] Improved INT stat scaling from 60 -> 75.
[*] [b]Joust:[/b] Reduced the damage bonus per tile moved from 10% -> 5%.
[*] [b]Lullaby:[/b] Changed rarity from Rare -> Common. Neru now starts with 4 Lullaby instead of 2.
[*] [b]Star Slam:[/b] Changed rarity from Common -> Rare. Neru now starts with 2 Star Slams instead of 4.
[/list]
[h2]Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dagger of Dusk:[/b] Now gives +3 INT, +3 DEX.
[*] [b]Luna's Lunch Box:[/b] Now costs 3 Red EP instead of 4.
[/list]
[h2]Status Effects[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Initiation Stance:[/b] Now gives +10% STR.
[*] [b]Follow-Up Stance:[/b] Now gives +10% DEX.
[*] [b]Tired:[/b] Reduced the amount of DEX and AGI lost per stack from -20% -> -10%.
[/list]
[h2]Characters[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buffed the stat growths of Neru, Luna, and Sophie.
[*] Increased the initial amount of Trade Points from 10 to 15.
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save and Load Menu now defaults to the current save slot instead of always the first one.
[*] Sophie now comes with starting equipment: Short Sword and Life Orb.
[*] Stats shown in the Party Menu now represent the unit's base stats instead of their grand total, including equipment.
[*] Improved card targeting behavior.
[*] Adjusted the versioning scheme of the game.
[/list]
